## Problem and change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior, including any compatibility impact.

## Validation

List the checks run and relevant results. Explain any checks that could not be run.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] My commits carry the DCO sign-off described in CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Relevant tests, documentation and protocol/version pins are updated.
- [ ] Copied or substantially AI-assisted work is identified, with provenance and validation.
- [ ] Third-party license and attribution requirements are preserved.
- [ ] Examples are suitable for public use; no secrets, customer data, private audit findings or temporary investigation reports are included.

Report vulnerabilities privately to security@gateway.fm; do not include them in this form.
